item.title: Book review: System Design Interview: An Insider’s Guide
item.description: Recently, I started rendering a list of interview preparation resources. Having not been in an interview process for 3 years made me realize that my skills may be a little rusty. After I spent some time on Reddit, Hacker News and some esoteric Discord servers, I ordered Alex Xu’s “System Design Interview: An Insider’s Guide”. Apart from that, I also purchased a LeetCode premium and some online courses*. Long story short, I think Alex’s SDI book might have been one of the best investments in my engineering prowess.
